g.text: Actual CAD profiles at the same scale. Plates hidden; the arms continue beyond this cropped root view.
Centred bolt pair: -4 / +4 mm along the arm.
Root width follows the 14 mm arm beam.
24 mm roots taper into 14 mm beams
Bolt 1: frame X -4 mm, Y 0 mm.
Bolt 2: frame X +4 mm, Y 0 mm.
Both: fitted joints, 0.2 mm arm gap, 10 x 10 mm compact key. Dot: root reference centre; dashed line: arm axis.
Wider root: 15 mm reach before a 20 mm taper. Custom offsets follow frame X/Y and mirror on left and rear arms.
